summary: Maddalena Parisi (1687–after 1756) of Guardia Lombardi in Campania, part of a Gialanella family group that is not connected to John's own ancestry.
bio: Maddalena Parisi was born in 1687 at Guardia Lombardi, Avellino, Campania, Italy, and died there some time after 1756. She belongs to a Gialanella family group that is recorded alongside John's relatives but is not part of his own line of descent.
